scope: P2 owner message attachment metadata and personal DM/group membership export

contract.ownership: Attachment rows join only messages authored by export owner; DM channels include owner in either position; group membership joins only current owner member row, never full roster. Own authored historical attachments remain exportable after leaving a group, consistently with the existing authored-message export.
contract.metadata_only: Stored filename, URL, size, MIME, timestamps, parent IDs and group file_key_index. No binary download or implicit file-access grant.
contract.encryption: Stored ciphertext and opaque e2ee_metadata are preserved unchanged. file_key_index is an ordinal, key_epoch a version; neither raw file/room keys nor new plaintext are exported. call_room_key is excluded.
